integrity: The general criterion is proved symbolically from the multiplicative order of an ambient primitive element and the size of its Frobenius orbit. The explicit Dickson example is replayed by exact finite-field arithmetic in the accompanying checker. Same-model review was performed; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns Definition 25 and Question 26 exactly as printed in arXiv:2609.10228v1. It distinguishes the literal ambient-field notion of primitive element from a plausible intended subfield-relative notion; under the repaired subfield-relative definition the intended equivalence holds.
title: Ambient primitivity changes the primitive-normal-basis criterion for Dickson distributive sets
